vendor_and_service: Hospital EHR vendor (SYS-01, including the sepsis model AI-001 and the ambulatory module used by the affiliated practices)
tier_rationale: PHI for about 310,000 individuals and the 18 practices' patients; supports BP-01 to BP-09 and BP-17
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Availability, Confidentiality)
subservice_organizations: Hosting data center provider carved out; e-prescribing network carved out
exceptions_noted: 2 exceptions: 2 of 40 terminated vendor staff removed late; 1 of 25 production changes lacked documented approval. Both remediated per management response
cuecs_and_company_mapping: User provisioning and removal; MFA; role design; audit log review; downtime procedures; feature activation decisions. Mapped to AC-2, IA-2(1), AU-6, CP-2, CM-4. Hospital gaps: access reviews (POAM-001), audit review (POAM-007), feature activation review (POAM-024)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 12 h and RPO 15 min; BIA needs RTO 2 h for clinical processes: **RTO does not meet the BIA** (P05 finding 1). RPO meets it
incident_notification_terms: Contract: notice within 72 hours of confirming a security incident; BAA: breach notice within 60 days
follow_up: Negotiate recovery terms and 5-business-day breach notice at the 2027 renewal; amend the BAA to cover practice PHI; request the model's subgroup validity data and change notice terms (P10); obtain the hosting provider's SOC 2
reviewer_and_date: Information Security Manager and Compliance and Privacy Officer, 2026-08-21

vendor_and_service: Managed security service provider (MSSP; SYS-10 operator)
tier_rationale: Security logs that can contain PHI fragments; privileged EDR agents on all servers and endpoints; detection for every process
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security); annual service review with detection tests
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: high-severity escalation missed the 30-minute target in 2 of 40 samples. Management added staff
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer defines log sources and escalation contacts, approves containment, reviews monthly reports. Mapped to IR-4, SI-4, AU-2. Hospital gap: log sources incomplete (POAM-007, POAM-020)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; its own continuity plan is tested annually per the report
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity; BAA: breach notice within 10 days
follow_up: Request the SIEM platform's SOC 2; add Availability to the next report scope request; track the escalation SLA monthly (P07 test: 22 minutes)

vendor_and_service: Public cloud provider (SYS-04 landing zone: interface engine, PACS hosting, data warehouse, file services, backup account)
tier_rationale: Hosts PHI workloads and the backup vault for every on-premises server
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (provider's published report)
subservice_organizations: None relevant to the services used
exceptions_noted: None relevant to the services used
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer responsibilities per the shared responsibility model: identity, keys, network rules, logging, backup configuration, restore testing. Mapped to the P04 control map (32 Customer, 20 Shared rows). Hospital gap: restore testing (POAM-011)
availability_vs_bia: Provider regional resilience supports the BIA; hospital-side recovery unproven
incident_notification_terms: Provider security incident notice terms in the BAA
follow_up: Map new services before use; keep the P04 map current

tier_rationale: Authenticates every user, including practice users; outage stops all sign-in
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Availability)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures MFA, conditional access, lifecycle, and break-glass. Mapped to IA-2(1), IA-2(2), AC-2, AC-7. Hospital gap: break-glass beyond the cloud (POL-02 4.11)
availability_vs_bia: 99.99% availability commitment; meets the 1-hour identity RTO
incident_notification_terms: Notice within 72 hours of a confirmed incident

tier_rationale: PHI for most patients; supports BP-09 and BP-13
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Availability)
opinion: Qualified (Availability: disaster recovery test not completed in the period)
exceptions_noted: Availability criterion A1.3 not met; 1 security exception on access removal
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer manages its user accounts and submitter credentials. Mapped to AC-2, IA-5
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 72 h; BIA MTD for BP-13 is 72 h: **meets only at the limit**; qualification confirms P01 R-020
follow_up: Secondary clearinghouse connection (P01 R-020); request DR test results by 2026-12-31
reviewer_and_date: Director of Revenue Cycle and Information Security Manager, 2026-08-26

vendor_and_service: PACS and RIS vendor (SYS-03, application managed in the hospital's workloads account; includes AI-002 integration)
tier_rationale: All images and reports; privileged access to the workloads account and, until 2026-10, the campus directory
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 or equivalent independent assessment
report_type_and_period: **None.** Vendor provided a security questionnaire and a penetration test summary (2025)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Hospital operates network, backups, and access around the application. Hospital gaps: vendor service accounts (POAM-002), vendor remote tool (POAM-003)
availability_vs_bia: Vendor support commitment 4 h response; recovery depends on the hospital's restore testing (POAM-011)
follow_up: **Require a SOC 2 Type 2 or HITRUST certification at the 2027 renewal**; until then, annual on-site review and quarterly access review of vendor accounts

vendor_and_service: Vendor access platform provider (remote support for 32 vendors today; all 46 by 2026-12-31)
tier_rationale: Privileged remote access path into clinical systems
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer approves vendor users, sessions, and recordings; customer integrates with the identity provider. Mapped to AC-17, MA-4
availability_vs_bia: Platform outage blocks vendor support only; acceptable
incident_notification_terms: Notice within 48 hours of a confirmed incident
follow_up: None beyond onboarding the remaining 14 vendors (POAM-003)

tier_rationale: Clinical documentation for ED and outpatient encounters at scale
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter (Security, Confidentiality)
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: access review for 1 of 4 quarters late
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer reviews suggestions and audits accuracy; customer manages user access. Mapped to AC-2, SA-9. Hospital action: monthly 50-claim audit (P10)
availability_vs_bia: Not critical: coders work without it (BP-13 MTD 72 h)
incident_notification_terms: BAA: breach notice within 30 days; no-training clause present
follow_up: Obtain the model hosting provider's SOC 2; confirm the no-training clause covers subcontractors

vendor_and_service: Ambient AI scribe vendor (AI-003 pilot, 12 ED physicians)
tier_rationale: Limited PHI during the pilot (audio and transcripts for about 60 ED encounters a day); becomes Tier 1 if expanded
assurance_required: Security questionnaire; SOC 2 if available; review before any expansion
subservice_organizations: Speech and language model hosting provider carved out
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer obtains recording consent and reviews every note. Mapped to PL-4, SA-9. Hospital gap: consent process (P10)
incident_notification_terms: Vendor standard BAA: breach notice within 60 days; permits use of de-identified data
follow_up: **Amend the BAA** (no training on hospital data; audio deleted within 7 days of note signing) before any expansion (P10)
